regions: sched trips of lines with stops in the hub
cols.bunch: consecutive scheduled rides of a route at a stop, scheduled headway 1–20 min: [pairs, bunched (actual headway < 30% of scheduled), double gaps (>= 2x)]; hours[[h, pairs, bunched]]; stops[[route_id, code, name, pairs, bunched]]; examples[[route_id, code, sched A, sched B, actual A, actual B]]
cols.regions file: days/D.regions.json = {hub: [[route_id, n, on-time n, sum delay (tenths of min)]]}
